text: Decks, mixer, library and your controller. Keep Mixxx as a backup if you like.
Go through a folder of new tracks: Space plays, the arrows jump between tracks, the whole waveform shows at once. In Dolphin: right-click tracks or a folder > Preview (DJOS).
Cut the silence at the start of an MP3, split a recorded set or join parts without losing quality: LosslessCut. Fades, volume, noise removal or recording: Audacity (it re-encodes when you export).
A whole folder the Mp3tag way (file name to tag and back): Puddletag. A few tracks, BPM, key and covers: Kid3. Tags filled in automatically: Picard.

task: Check the quality of a file
text: Is that 320 kbps MP3 real? The spectrum tells: a real one reaches 19-20 kHz.
MP3 or AIFF copies of FLAC and WAV files, many at once (for a USB stick or another DJ app).
Richie DJ records your mix by itself. For video and live streams, OBS Studio; to edit the video afterwards, Kdenlive. Recording a turntable or a mixer: Audacity.
Record and mix: Ardour. Electronic tracks and remixes: Bitwig Studio or REAPER. First beats: LMMS.
Ardour and Carla already have the Fedora LV2 / VST3 / CLAP plugins. The Flathub DAWs get theirs from the packs.
See and change which app sends sound where. An EQ for the headphones or the browser (never for a set): EasyEffects. A Flathub app can't see your music disk: Flatseal.
